text: So Alex, it's peak humpback whale season right now and the numbers are just phenomenal. Boats out of the Gold Coast and Hervey Bay are reporting whales basically everywhere you look, breaching, tail slapping, the whole lot.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah I heard a bloke on the radio say he counted a dozen breaches in twenty minutes off Burleigh, which is a pretty good strike rate for a Saturday arvo. These fellas are cruising up from Antarctica to have their calves in our warmer waters, then heading home again, it's an epic road trip really.

speaker: alice
text: And here's the good news bit, populations have been steadily climbing for years now after being hunted almost to nothing last century. Meanwhile marine biologists are chuffed with how the Great Barrier Reef is looking heading into spawning season, coral cover is holding up better than a lot of people expected.
